integrity: The numerical coefficients were obtained by exhaustive enumeration of 4096 directed masks and a transparent finite recurrence; no inferred infinite enumeration is claimed.
scientific_limitations: A labelled four-world, diagonal-one, max–min fuzzy-preorder census. Does not count general sizes, quotient by isomorphism, non-min t-norms, or the distribution of transitive closures. Finite enumeration is reproducible; independent external audit is unperformed.
title: The exact four-world law for finite-valued max–min fuzzy preorders
